scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: I'm Diego, reporter of the Aurora Expedition! Maya, where did you go at the weekend?
scene.intro: Reporter Diego has a new mission: to make a map of every amazing place in town! On Saturday he follows Maya with his microphone — to the museum with the dinosaur bones, to the old bridge over the green river, and to the theatre where a dragon appears on the stage. Some places are noisy, some are quiet, and one of them hides the best ice cream in the city. Where do YOU go at the weekend? Let's find out how to talk about it!

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (reportero, enérgico) y Maya (científica, tranquila).
data.script: Diego: Good morning, Maya! This is Radio Aurora. Where did you go at the weekend? … Maya: Hi Diego! On Saturday morning I went to the museum with my aunt. … Diego: The museum? What did you see? … Maya: We saw dinosaur bones! Then we had lunch at a restaurant near the bridge. … Diego: Lovely! And in the afternoon? … Maya: We watched a play at the theatre. It was about a dragon. … Diego: And on Sunday? … Maya: On Sunday my cousin's team played, so we went to the stadium. They won two–one! … Diego: What a weekend! Thank you, Maya.

data.text: Saturday was fantastic! In the morning, Aunt Rosa took me to the city museum. My favourite room was the one with the dinosaur bones — some of them are eighty million years old! At midday we were hungry, so we ate rice and fish at a small restaurant near the old bridge. In the afternoon we watched a play about a friendly dragon at the theatre. On Sunday, my cousin's football team played at the big stadium. They won, and my cousin scored the first goal!
